entries.providerBehavior: GitHub PR review state is split across merged/state/draft flags and the native reviewDecision, which may disagree with the raw state.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: Every PR variant maps to one closed DeliveryRequestReviewState; a merged or closed PR never reports open; an unrecognized native reviewDecision resolves to the declared open fallback instead of a silent default, and a flattening regression fails by trap name.

entries.providerBehavior: A commit can carry several check runs per SHA plus a check-suite roll-up whose conclusion can be greener than an individual run.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: read-pipeline-run for the SHA returns every check run as a job with a closed-set state and trace evidence where a details URL exists; a failed run is never hidden behind the roll-up and SHAs yield disjoint sets.

entries.providerBehavior: GitHub issue payloads carry labels, an optional assignee, open/closed state, an optional updated_at, issue links, and a state_reason on live closed issues.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: Issues normalize to WorkItem with labels, an optional assignee, a closed-set status alias (open to ready, closed to done), updatedAt verbatim when present (absent otherwise), and typed relations only when the payload records them. state_reason is not modeled: closed maps to done regardless of not_planned, and live-shape revalidation plus any canceled distinction is deferred to M0-S20.

entries.providerBehavior: The repository issue-list endpoint returns both issues and pull-request objects in one page.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: listWorkItems skips every object carrying a pull_request property before normalization, so the returned WorkItem set contains no pull-request object while the raw page size is preserved for the source-at-limit signal.

entries.providerBehavior: List reads are unbounded unless the client sends one declared per_page limit, and the raw returned page size can equal that limit.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: Each list read sends exactly one page with state=open, the declared per_page limit, and the declared updated-descending sort; the raw page size is reported separately from the filtered item count so a full page signals possible truncation.

entries.providerBehavior: The real GitHub REST issue list does not supply structured issue dependency links.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: An issue without issue_links normalizes to relations: [], and the tracker source declares blocked-dependency relations unavailable rather than empty.

entries.providerBehavior: The GitHub pull-request list payload carries state/draft/head/base but no review decision or review threads.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: The list read normalizes refs/draft/state and leaves the absent review decision and threads untrusted, so status reports those item signals unknown instead of open or zero.

entries.providerBehavior: A work item can have several closed PRs; only merged PRs whose source ref follows the branch convention are candidates, and the merged head is copied verbatim or stays absent.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: Lookup selects the highest numeric matching merged entity deterministically and copies head.sha; an absent head never fabricates a value.

entries.providerBehavior: GitHub label updates are a full-array replace, so a named remove/add must preserve every unnamed label.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: write-work-item removes only named lifecycle labels, adds delivered, and preserves change and vendor labels.

entries.providerBehavior: Review-thread resolution is a GraphQL mutation behind the existing injected transport, not a REST write.
entries.expectedNormalizedOutcome: resolve-delivery-thread posts one GraphQL mutation with the thread id and succeeds on a resolved thread payload.
